task: T5: write scripts/dispatch/README.md describing the contract this module implements, in prose a reader can check the code against. Cover: the single supported verb and what an unrecognised message does; why dedupe is keyed on the event id rather than the sync cursor; each bound the rendered Job always carries and the reason each exists; the two environment variables that select the apply command and the worker image; and the rule that the dispatcher validates, maps, launches and records, with every judgment living in the worker. State plainly that the module deliberately contains no model call, no gate invocation and no retry loop, and that the HTTP read API is a separate future surface. Do not restate the whole spec — this is the contract as a maintainer would need it, not a copy.
